articles.title: AlloyDB Ships Proxy Models That Replace LLM Calls with Local Inference Inside the Database
articles.reason: Demonstrates a practical architecture for reducing LLM inference costs and latency by training local proxy models, which is relevant for building scalable, cost-effective GenAI pipelines in enterprise settings.
articles.summary: Google's AlloyDB now supports AI functions that use a proxy model architecture: a lightweight local model is trained from LLM outputs and then used for high-throughput, low-latency inference directly inside the database. This approach eliminates external LLM calls, significantly improving speed and potentially reducing operational costs. While benchmarks are internal, the architecture offers a concrete pattern for optimizing RAG and agentic workflows in production.
